# three.js r180 (MIT)

Copied from the `three@0.180.0` npm package and loaded only when the vehicle
overview opens in 3D. Files are renamed to `.mjs` and their import specifiers
point to the sibling module files (`'three'` → `./three.module.min.mjs`,
`./three.core.min.js` → `./three.core.min.mjs`). No other changes. See `LICENSE`.
